Amex Membership Rewards points

Amex Membership Rewards points can be transferred to a long list of airline and hotel partners. On the AirMilesHK Marketplace, members list the Amex Membership Rewards points they have, and buyers make offers or request a booking. When a deal is agreed, AirMilesHK holds the payment until the seller delivers.

How it works

Trading Amex Membership Rewards points, safely

  1. Browse or listAnyone can browse Amex Membership Rewards listings. Joining is free and needed to make an offer or list your own points.
  2. Make an offerBid on part of a balance, the whole account where offered, or ask the seller to book a booking for you.
  3. Agree the termsThe seller accepts, counters or declines. Counter as often as you need.
  4. AirMilesHK in the middleThe buyer pays AirMilesHK, the seller delivers, and we release the payment once both sides confirm.
Most loyalty programmes, including Amex Membership Rewards, do not allow selling or transferring points or accounts. Please read the marketplace rules before you trade. Prefer a simple purchase? See AirMilesHK's own Amex Membership Rewards page.
